Removal volume (P1): the mock-up

Your call: reply in chat with Approve, Change (say what) or Rethink. Approve starts slice S1 (the numbers); S2 (the stock box and your own stock) follows in its own session.

Screenshots of the real app on real parts: clean_pocket.step from the test parts and NIST CTC 01. The numbers are real: the spec's formula run on each part. The new lines (shaded here so you can find them), the Stock button and the stock fields are drawn into the page for the picture; the see-through box comes from a throwaway prototype that will not be kept. Slice S1: how much comes off

1. Two new lines under Stock

2. The same two lines in the PDF

In S1 the numbers also go into the result file the app keeps for each part (a removal block: stock, part, total, each hole's and pocket's own volume, explained and not explained). The volume of each hole is its diameter and depth; of each pocket, its floor area times its depth. Both are approximate by design (spec, "Feature volumes").

Slice S2: the stock box and your own stock

3. Stock box, on by default

4. Your own stock

Choices in this mock-up that the spec leaves open

Each is my default; say if you want it otherwise.

  1. Not explained stays on the part-size block when you type your stock, and says so: "0.03 % of the part-size removal". The extra layer is facing and shows in the facing lines, so it is not counted again as "not explained". The spec says the removal line uses your stock but doesn't say this.
  2. The Stock button shows on the Machining step only, beside the view buttons at the left end of their row; in the Machine view the view buttons hide, and so do the button and the box.
  3. Words: on screen "Not explained" (short, to fit the left column) with the reason after the number; in the PDF "Not explained by a found feature". Big volumes get thousands commas in in³ too (2,401.60 in³).
  4. Your stock lasts until you open another part (not saved; spec R6 says session only).
  5. The PDF lines show whenever the Stock line shows there, and always use the part-size block (your typed stock is not in the PDF; spec R6).

What doesn't change: the plan, setups, tools, findings and cost stay as they are (spec J7); removal is not a cost driver until time and cost (P4). Milled parts only; a turned part shows no removal lines.
